description: Validate an IBAN's country code, length, format and check digits for any of the 89 IBAN countries, and name the bank behind its bank code (name, BIC, head office) where the directory has it. A valid IBAN doesn't prove the account exists or belongs to the payee; confirm the account holder's name before paying.
